Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The tree of Prophethood
And the place of the Message
And the frequenting place of angels
And the mine of knowledge
And the people of the house of revelation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The ark sailing in the overwhelming depths
Whoever boards it is safe
And whoever abandons it drowns
The one who precedes them is deviant
And the one who lags behind them perishes
And the one who adheres to them joins (salvation)

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The secure fortress
And the helper of the distressed and humble
And the refuge of those who flee
And the protection of those who seek protection

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Abundant blessings that please them

Arabic text: وَلِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ أَدَاءً وَقَضَاءً
Translation: And fulfill and discharge the rights of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: بِحَوْلٍ مِنْكَ وَقُوَّةٍ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: By Your might and power, O Lord of the Worlds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The pure, the virtuous, the excellent
Those whose rights You have made obligatory
And made their obedience and authority mandatory

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And build my heart with Your obedience
And do not disgrace me with disobedience to You

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ مُوَاسَاةَ مَنْ قَتَّرْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
Translation: And grant me the ability to support those whose provision You have restricted
Through what You have expanded for me from Your grace
And spread over me from Your justice
And kept me alive under Your shade
And this is the month of Your Prophet, the master of Your messengers

Arabic text: شَعْبَانُ الَّذِيْ حَفَفْتَهُ مِنْكَ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَالرِّضْوَانِ
Translation: Sha'ban, which You have surrounded with mercy and pleasure

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
Translation: In which the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family
Would exert himself in fasting and standing (in prayer)
During its nights and days
In humility to You, honoring and venerating it
Until the time of his death

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَأَعِنَّا عَلَىْ الْإِسْتِنَانِ بِسُنَّتِهِ فِيهِ
Translation: O Allah, help us to follow his tradition in it
And to attain his intercession
O Allah, make him an intercessor for me, whose intercession is accepted
And a clear path towards You
And make me a follower of him

Arabic text: حَتّىٰ أَلْقَاكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَنِّيْ رَاضِيًا
Translation: Until I meet You on the Day of Resurrection while You are pleased with me
And overlooking my sins

Arabic text: قَدْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِيْ مِنْكَ الرَّحْمَةَ وَالرِّضْوَانَ
Translation: You having made obligatory for me Your mercy and pleasure
And settled me in the abode of permanence and the place of the righteous
